tutorial_title: How do you get the connection details?
test_ok: It works: {{platform}} answered and the key can read products and orders.
gomag_desc: Hontrio reads products and orders from Gomag with an API key. It doesn’t change anything in your store.
gomag_store_url_hint: The address your customers open, as Gomag knows it.
gomag_step_1_title: Open the API section of your Gomag admin
gomag_step_1_desc: Usually under Settings → Integrations → API. If you don’t see it, ask the Gomag team to turn on API access.
gomag_step_2_desc: Name it Hontrio. If you can choose its rights, reading products and orders is enough: Hontrio doesn’t change anything.
gomag_step_3_desc: Together with the store’s address, the one your customers open.
merchantpro_desc: Hontrio reads products and orders from MerchantPro with a read-only API user. It doesn’t change anything in your store.
merchantpro_store_url_hint: The store’s domain: the MerchantPro API answers on it.
merchantpro_step_1_desc: At flex.merchantpro.com, with an account that has Developer access.
merchantpro_step_2_title: Settings → API and webhooks → API Users
merchantpro_step_2_desc: Click Add API user and give it a name, for example Hontrio.
merchantpro_step_3_title: Give it read-only rights for products and orders
merchantpro_step_3_desc: Hontrio doesn’t change anything in your store, so it doesn’t need write rights.
merchantpro_step_4_title: Save and copy the API User and API Secret
merchantpro_step_4_desc: The secret stays only with you and in Hontrio, encrypted.
opencart_desc: The OpenCart API can’t read products and orders, so Hontrio comes with a free extension. It only reads, and saves the visit’s source on each order, for example a Google ad.
opencart_store_url_hint: If OpenCart is in a folder, include it too (for example https://your-store.com/shop).
opencart_api_key_placeholder: The key from the extension’s page
opencart_step_1_title: Download the extension for your version
opencart_step_1_desc: The version is shown at the bottom of the OpenCart admin (for example 3.0.3.8 or 4.0.2.3).
opencart_step_2_desc: Upload the archive as you downloaded it. In OpenCart 4 it must be named exactly hontrio.ocmod.zip (not hontrio (1).ocmod.zip); then click Install next to Hontrio in the list below.
opencart_step_3_desc: Install the module (the + button), then open it (the pencil).
opencart_step_4_desc: Together with the store’s address. A new key, generated on the extension’s page, replaces the old one.
